messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and timeout surge observed for inference-hosted-prod (us-east-1a) at 2026-03-16T02:18:10Z — 5xx rate ~14% over 5m, error types: CUDA OOM, segfaults, gateway timeouts. Pager fired.

Tim (oncall): ack — joining. Who's owning runtime diagnostics?

Raj (eng-runtime): Im on it. Observing recurring OOM kills and SIGSEGVs in the model-runner on hosted GPU nodes after a canary push of runt:3.5.0-quant2 at ~01:55 UTC. Snippet from pod logs:
``
[2026-03-16T01:58:03Z] model-runner[pid=9981]: ERROR: signal 11 (Segmentation fault)
[2026-03-16T01:58:03Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 9981 (model-runner)
```

Maria (support): Confirmed two P1 customer reports (tickets INC-3301, INC-3302) showing 502s and client timeouts on chat flows using long_prompt mode.

Elaine (SRE): Any infra or deploy changes besides the runtime bump? Canary settings changed?

Raj (eng-runtime): The only notable change was the new kv_cache pruning heuristic in 3.5.0-quant2. Memory climbs steadily with sessions > 40k tokens causing fragmentation and failed CUDA allocations.

Tim (oncall): Triage plan — short-term mitigations: 1) apply traffic split to prefer a lower-memory model variant, 2) cap max_tokens_per_request to reduce per-request memory, 3) selectively restart affected pods. Elaine, can you apply the routing split?

Elaine (SRE): On it. Applying routing override to shift 80% of redwood-large workload to redwood-lite-v0 for 60m. Also setting per-pod concurrency limit to 3 to reduce simultaneous allocations.

DeployBot: Traffic override applied by Elaine at 2026-03-16T02:24:30Z (80% -> redwood-lite-v0, per-pod concurrency=3).

Raj (eng-runtime): Collecting core dumps and backtraces from failed pods. Commands run: 
``
kubectl annotate pod <pod> debug=true
kubectl exec -it <pod> -- gcore $(pidof model-runner)
scp <pod>:/tmp/core.* /tmp/diagnostics/
```
Initial backtrace points to kv_cache_shrink / evict paths in runtime 3.5.0.

Sonia (product): Which customers are impacted? Any Dedicated clusters affected?

Raj (eng-runtime): So far, only the shared hosted pool shows the pattern. Dedicated/reserved clusters remain stable. We should proactively notify hosted customers using long-context models.

Maria (support): Messaging sent to the two P1 customers with mitigation steps and ETA ~40m for full stabilization. Advising usage of fallback models where acceptable.

Tim (oncall): If the restarts and routing don't drop error rates quickly, we should rollback runt:3.5.0-quant2 to 3.4.3. Raj, can you stage a canary rollback?

Raj (eng-runtime): Initiating canary rollback on two nodes now. Observability: client 5xx dropped from 14% to ~4% after traffic split and restarts.

Elaine (SRE): Draining affected nodes: cordon/drain those with repeated OOMs. Also bumping node-level memory reservation to avoid kernel-level OOM kills during restarts.

Tim (oncall): Keep pager rotation active. Ill hand off to Avery in ~45m but will remain reachable for rollback approval.

Raj (eng-runtime): Canary rollback to runt:3.4.3 shows no segfaults for 12m. Beginning batch rollback across remaining hosted nodes with small batches of 8 nodes. Also pushing temporary config override: max_context_tokens=4096.

DeployBot: Rollback to runt:3.4.3 started by Raj at 2026-03-16T02:48:12Z (batch size: 8 nodes).

Maria (support): Error rate dropping to ~0.7% after rollback and traffic override. Customers acknowledge and will monitor.

Elaine (SRE): Observability notes: p50 latency up ~30-50ms due to routing to lighter model; p95 up ~100-150ms while node restarts occur. No client-side timeouts observed beyond initial surge.

Tim (oncall): Once error rate settles below 1% for 20 minutes, we'll remove the routing override and restore prior limits. Raj, confirm telemetry then remove overrides.

Raj (eng-runtime): Rollback completed at 2026-03-16T03:12:00Z. Metrics steady. Removing traffic override and restoring concurrency/context settings.

DeployBot: Traffic override removed by Raj at 2026-03-16T03:15:22Z. Configs restored to default.

Maria (support): P1 tickets updated: status=monitoring. No SLA breaches for Dedicated customers. Customers advised to retry failed sessions.

Elaine (SRE): Creating postmortem PM-INC-2026-0316. Action items: revert the kv_cache heuristic introduced in 3.5.0-quant2, add memory/regression tests simulating long-context growth, harden canary by exercising long-context workloads, introduce earlier GPU OOM rate alerts, and reserve warm spare capacity to reduce blast radius. Assigning to eng-runtime + SRE.

Raj (eng-runtime): Ill lead the postmortem. Uploading core dumps, backtraces, and memory profiles to the ticket. Also will add an e2e perf test that simulates incremental KV expansion across sequences.

Avery (oncall): ack — taking over live monitoring and follow-ups. Will watch PM actions and ensure remediation lands. Great job team. :thumbsup: 

IncidentBot: Incident resolved at 2026-03-16T03:40:05Z — error rate normalized. Postmortem record created PM-INC-2026-0316. Please complete postmortem within 5 business days.

-- end of thread --
